description: Shared release identity, immutable runtime image, planning, activation, rollback, and garbage-collection contract for desktop and CLI products.

authority.rule: Transport and installers may stage verified bytes, but only Core may select, fence, reconcile, commit, roll back, or collect a runtime generation.

invariants: installing bytes never grants live runtime authority
every live generation pins one immutable runtimeBuildId and artifactRoot
a new generation becomes active only after semantic readiness succeeds
active work is never killed merely to make an update automatic
irreversible migration requires explicit backup or restore evidence and approval
rollback and garbage collection never delete Episode or workspace facts
unknown image ownership or references fail closed

target-not-installed.title: The update is ready to install
target-not-installed.whatHappened: Verified runtime bytes are available but are not installed yet.
target-not-installed.activeWork: Current work keeps using its pinned runtime.
target-not-installed.activation: The new runtime can be selected only after installation and Core readiness.
target-not-installed.userAction: Install the verified image, then review the Core activation plan.
target-not-installed.dataAndSessions: Workspace data and active sessions are not rewritten.

already-current.title: Kungfu is already current
already-current.whatHappened: The selected runtime already matches this release.
already-current.dataAndSessions: Workspace data and sessions remain unchanged.

workspace-idle.title: The update can activate now
workspace-idle.whatHappened: Core found no active work that must stay pinned to the current runtime.
workspace-idle.activeWork: No active work will be interrupted.
workspace-idle.activation: The new runtime activates after semantic readiness succeeds.
workspace-idle.dataAndSessions: Workspace data is preserved; only runtime routing changes.

active-work-compatible.title: Current work continues during the update
active-work-compatible.whatHappened: The new runtime is compatible with the runtime pinned by active work.
active-work-compatible.activeWork: Current work continues on its exact existing bytes.
active-work-compatible.activation: New work moves after a fenced safe-point handoff.
active-work-compatible.dataAndSessions: Data and session facts are preserved across the handoff.

active-work-incompatible.title: The update is waiting for current work
active-work-incompatible.whatHappened: The target runtime cannot safely share the active compatibility window.
active-work-incompatible.activeWork: Current work continues on its pinned runtime.
active-work-incompatible.activation: The new runtime waits until the workspace is idle.
active-work-incompatible.userAction: Finish the current work; do not force a restart for the update.
active-work-incompatible.dataAndSessions: No data or session is changed while the update waits.

active-work-must-be-idle.title: The update is waiting for current work
active-work-must-be-idle.whatHappened: The selected Release Cut cannot activate while incompatible work remains active.
active-work-must-be-idle.activeWork: Current work continues on its pinned runtime.
active-work-must-be-idle.activation: The new Release Cut waits until the workspace is idle.
active-work-must-be-idle.userAction: Finish the current work; do not force a restart for the update.
active-work-must-be-idle.dataAndSessions: No data or session is changed while the update waits.

provider-resume-required.title: This work needs a supported resume
provider-resume-required.whatHappened: The provider must open a new physical attempt on the target runtime.
provider-resume-required.activeWork: The current attempt remains pinned until a safe point.
provider-resume-required.activation: Activation follows a provider-supported resume, not fabricated continuity.
provider-resume-required.userAction: End at a safe point and use the provider resume action.
provider-resume-required.dataAndSessions: Recorded facts remain; the resumed attempt receives a new physical identity.

provider-resume-unsupported.title: The update cannot continue this provider work
provider-resume-unsupported.whatHappened: The active provider cannot prove a safe resume on the target runtime.
provider-resume-unsupported.activeWork: Current work is left running on its pinned runtime.
provider-resume-unsupported.activation: The update stays blocked for this workspace.
provider-resume-unsupported.userAction: Finish or explicitly stop the non-resumable work before activating.
provider-resume-unsupported.dataAndSessions: Kungfu does not invent PTY or provider continuity.

irreversible-migration-needs-approval.title: Approval and recovery evidence are required
irreversible-migration-needs-approval.whatHappened: This release declares an irreversible migration.
irreversible-migration-needs-approval.activeWork: Current work remains on the existing runtime.
irreversible-migration-needs-approval.activation: Activation is blocked until recovery evidence and approval exist.
irreversible-migration-needs-approval.userAction: Create and verify backup or restore evidence, then approve explicitly.
irreversible-migration-needs-approval.dataAndSessions: No migration is performed before approval.

rollback-unavailable.title: Automatic rollback is unavailable
rollback-unavailable.whatHappened: The release contract cannot prove a safe automatic return to the prior runtime.
rollback-unavailable.activeWork: Kungfu does not force a runtime switch.
rollback-unavailable.userAction: Follow the documented recovery path before proceeding.
rollback-unavailable.dataAndSessions: Rollback never deletes workspace, Episode, or session facts.

manual-rollback-needs-approval.title: Manual rollback approval is required
manual-rollback-needs-approval.whatHappened: This release requires an explicit manual rollback plan.
manual-rollback-needs-approval.activeWork: Current work remains on its pinned runtime.
manual-rollback-needs-approval.activation: Activation waits until the manual rollback path is reviewed and approved.
manual-rollback-needs-approval.userAction: Review and approve the documented manual rollback path before proceeding.
manual-rollback-needs-approval.dataAndSessions: No runtime route, workspace, Episode, or session fact changes before approval.

stale-generation.title: The update plan is stale
stale-generation.whatHappened: The active runtime generation changed after this plan was created.
stale-generation.activation: No bytes are activated from the stale plan.
stale-generation.userAction: Refresh status and create a new plan.
stale-generation.dataAndSessions: No workspace or session fact is rolled back by the stale request.

readiness-failed.title: The new runtime did not become ready
readiness-failed.whatHappened: Semantic readiness failed after staging the target generation.
readiness-failed.activeWork: Existing work stays on its pinned runtime.
readiness-failed.activation: Core restores the prior route when the release permits automatic rollback.
readiness-failed.userAction: Review diagnostics only if recovery cannot complete automatically.
readiness-failed.dataAndSessions: Workspace, Episode, and session facts are retained.

unknown-image-reference.title: Runtime cleanup needs review
unknown-image-reference.whatHappened: Core found a runtime reference whose owner cannot be proved.
unknown-image-reference.userAction: Inspect advanced diagnostics before retrying cleanup.
unknown-image-reference.dataAndSessions: Unknown ownership fails closed; no image or fact is deleted.

safe-to-collect.title: Unused runtime images can be removed
safe-to-collect.whatHappened: Core proved that the planned images have no live or recovery references.
safe-to-collect.activeWork: Active and retained work is not affected.
safe-to-collect.userAction: Review the deterministic cleanup plan before applying it.
safe-to-collect.dataAndSessions: Cleanup owns runtime images only, never workspace or Episode facts.

new-product-version.title: A Kungfu update is available
new-product-version.whatHappened: A qualified release manifest describes a newer product version for this host.
new-product-version.activeWork: Checking or downloading does not change current work.
new-product-version.activation: The new runtime takes effect only after installation and Core readiness.
new-product-version.userAction: Review the plan, then choose the update action for this install source.
new-product-version.dataAndSessions: Workspace data and sessions remain unchanged during check and download.

frontend-authority-external.title: Use the owner of this installation
frontend-authority-external.whatHappened: This frontend is managed by a desktop app, package manager, or native installer.
frontend-authority-external.activation: Kungfu will not replace manager-owned frontend files.
frontend-authority-external.userAction: Use the exact manager action shown, or follow the release instructions.
frontend-authority-external.dataAndSessions: Shared runtime and workspace facts remain separate from frontend ownership.

release-unqualified.title: This release is not eligible to install
release-unqualified.whatHappened: The manifest has no retained qualification evidence for publication.
release-unqualified.activeWork: Current work continues on its existing runtime.
release-unqualified.activation: No candidate bytes receive runtime authority.
release-unqualified.userAction: Obtain a qualified release from the authoritative channel.
release-unqualified.dataAndSessions: No workspace or session data is changed.

artifact-verification-failed.title: The downloaded update did not verify
artifact-verification-failed.whatHappened: The candidate size or SHA-256 digest differs from the release manifest.
artifact-verification-failed.activeWork: Current work continues on its existing runtime.
artifact-verification-failed.activation: The candidate is not installed or activated.
artifact-verification-failed.userAction: Discard the candidate bytes and retry from a fresh qualified plan.
artifact-verification-failed.dataAndSessions: No workspace or session data is changed.

downgrade-refused.title: Kungfu did not downgrade this installation
downgrade-refused.whatHappened: The selected release is older than the installed product version.
downgrade-refused.activeWork: Current work continues on its existing frontend and pinned runtime.
downgrade-refused.activation: No older frontend or runtime receives authority from this request.
downgrade-refused.userAction: Use the documented recovery procedure only after deciding which facts and compatibility window must be preserved.
downgrade-refused.dataAndSessions: No product image, runtime route, workspace, Episode, or session fact is changed.

action-required.title: The update needs your attention
action-required.whatHappened: Kungfu cannot prove that the requested update step is safe automatically.
action-required.activeWork: Current work remains on its pinned runtime whenever possible.
action-required.activation: The update does not advance until the stated condition is resolved.
action-required.userAction: Follow the single next action and retry from a fresh status.
action-required.dataAndSessions: Kungfu preserves workspace, Episode, and session facts.
